sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "piston_machines" ("serial" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_ms" INTEGER NULL, "checked_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (complete IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(serial));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recipients" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "empty_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "is_portafilter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_portafilter IN (0, 1)), "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_methods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "template_type" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "machine" TEXT NULL, "machine_address" TEXT NULL, "vessel_name" TEXT NULL, "vessel_grams" REAL NULL, "default_recipient_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recipients(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "pour_plan_json" TEXT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "piston_method_links" ("method_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brew_methods(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "serial" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES piston_machines(serial)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(method_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "piston_measurements" ("serial" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES piston_machines(serial)ON DELETE CASCADE, "shot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "current" REAL NULL, "speed" REAL NULL, "samples" INTEGER NOT NULL, "algorithm" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(serial, shot_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "piston_maintenances" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "serial" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES piston_machines(serial)ON DELETE CASCADE, "time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roasters" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "roaster" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "paid_price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "roast_level" TEXT NULL, "flavor_profile" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_favorite IN (0, 1)), "is_decaf" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_decaf IN (0, 1)), "shop_url" TEXT NULL, "rest_days" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_roaster_links" ("coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "roaster_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roasters(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(coffee_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cafes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "latitude" REAL NULL, "longitude" REAL NULL, "source_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "source_url" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cafe_drinks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cafe_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cafes(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "roaster_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES roasters(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "drink_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_name" TEXT NULL, "origin_country" TEXT NULL, "process" TEXT NULL, "variety" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR', "drank_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cafe_drink_photos" ("drink_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cafe_drinks(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(drink_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_components" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "region" TEXT NULL, "farm" TEXT NULL, "producer" TEXT NULL, "variety" TEXT NULL, "process" TEXT NULL, "altitude_meters" INTEGER NULL, "altitude_max_meters" INTEGER NULL, "harvest" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), UNIQUE(coffee_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "roast_date" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "opened_date" TEXT NULL, "initial_grams" REAL NULL, "remaining_grams" REAL NULL, "overdraw_grams" REAL NULL, "frozen_pause_days" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "frozen_portions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffee_lots(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "container" TEXT NULL, "frozen_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "initial_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "remaining_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "thawed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), UNIQUE(label));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grinders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "has_adjustable_feeder_rpm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (has_adjustable_feeder_rpm IN (0, 1)), "has_adjustable_rpm" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (has_adjustable_rpm IN (0, 1)), "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "gh_ppm_as_caco3" REAL NULL, "kh_ppm_as_caco3" REAL NULL, "tds_ppm" REAL NULL, "ph" REAL NULL, "calcium_ppm" REAL NULL, "magnesium_ppm" REAL NULL, "sodium_ppm" REAL NULL, "potassium_ppm" REAL NULL, "chloride_ppm" REAL NULL, "sulfate_ppm" REAL NULL, "bicarbonate_ppm" REAL NULL, "recipe_json" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "method_tools" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "method_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES brew_methods(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "merged_into_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES method_tools(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tool_method_links" ("tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_tools(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "method_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brew_methods(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(tool_id, method_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brews" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "lot_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES coffee_lots(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "method_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES brew_methods(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "grinder_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES grinders(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "water_profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES water_profiles(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "water_profile_name" TEXT NULL, "is_pre_ground" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_pre_ground IN (0, 1)), "method_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grinder_name" TEXT NULL, "grind_setting" TEXT NULL, "dose_grams" REAL NULL, "frozen_portion_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES frozen_portions(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "frozen_dose_grams" REAL NULL, "water_grams" REAL NULL, "beverage_grams" REAL NULL, "recipient_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recipients(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, "recipient_name" TEXT NULL, "recipient_grams" REAL NULL, "recipient_is_portafilter" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (recipient_is_portafilter IN (0, 1)), "time_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "temperature_c" REAL NULL, "brix" REAL NULL, "brix_factor" REAL NULL, "feeder_rpm" INTEGER NULL, "tds_percent" REAL NULL, "grind_rpm" INTEGER NULL, "pressure_bar" REAL NULL, "preinfusion_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "bloom_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "bloom_count" INTEGER NULL, "pour_count" INTEGER NULL, "pour_phases_json" TEXT NULL, "first_drip_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "taste_balance" INTEGER NULL, "taste_strength" INTEGER NULL, "acidity" INTEGER NULL, "sweetness" INTEGER NULL, "bitterness" INTEGER NULL, "body" INTEGER NULL, "aftertaste" INTEGER NULL, "profile_name" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_favorite IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NULL, "brewed_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "archived_by_coffee" INTEGER NULL CHECK (archived_by_coffee IN (0, 1)), "stock_review_pending" INTEGER NULL CHECK (stock_review_pending IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY(id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_curves" ("brew_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brews(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "samples_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(brew_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "coffee_photos" ("coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(coffee_id, position));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_photos" ("brew_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brews(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(brew_id, position));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "brew_tool_selections" ("brew_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brews(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "tool_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES method_tools(id)ON DELETE RESTRICT, PRIMARY KEY(brew_id, tool_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_entity" TEXT NULL, "local_id" TEXT NULL, "imported_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), UNIQUE(source, kind, external_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "legacy_payloads" ("import_record_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_records(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "raw_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(import_record_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_preferences" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "share_fields_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "hidden_brew_fields_json" TEXT NULL, "rate_reminder_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "locale_code" TEXT NULL, "last_backup_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "scale_device_id" TEXT NULL, "scale_name" TEXT NULL, "scales_json" TEXT NULL, "list_options_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_adjustments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "coffee_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffees(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES coffee_lots(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "frozen_portion_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES frozen_portions(id)ON DELETE SET NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_grams" REAL NULL, "resulting_grams" REAL NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reversed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cupping_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "draft_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "completed_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, "created_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cupping_session_cups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cupping_sessions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "brew_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brews(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(id), UNIQUE(session_id, position), UNIQUE(brew_id));
CREATE INDEX brew_history ON brews (brewed_at_ms DESC, created_at_ms DESC, id ASC)
CREATE INDEX brew_active_history ON brews (archived_at_ms, brewed_at_ms DESC, created_at_ms DESC, id ASC)
CREATE INDEX brew_coffee_history ON brews (coffee_id, brewed_at_ms DESC, created_at_ms DESC, id ASC)
CREATE INDEX brew_coffee_recipe ON brews (coffee_id, archived_at_ms, is_favorite DESC, brewed_at_ms DESC, created_at_ms DESC, id ASC)
